This draft preserves the inactive paired NBA operating work and adds an offline, credentialless source replay with a private local website review. **Actual new source result: 28 player-stat rows observed, 28 parsed, zero complete contracts.** The complete-contract milestone remains unmet; these observations are not publicly admitted offers or ticket candidates.

Branch: `implementation/one-event-paired-pilot`  
Current head: `9a7bdcb019697d972990f81ff31913b75dd44e24`  
New parser/preview implementation source: `730f4ea58c7e3c3a08eb44d8d7f33d6f5108d501`  
Unchanged operating source: `6777025deca7c03636f5cb6739cfcc77cb0b5e49`

PR #12 stays **draft**, stacked on unchanged draft PR #10 at `c0a7b4bc3205d723b13d0f70baf66f3806e731ee`. PROS004/S0 remain inactive. No landing, deployment, scheduler or genuine issuance is requested or performed. The earlier ChatGPT commits and all later legitimate work remain ancestors.

### Actual keyless source and remaining contract work

ESPN/DraftKings and Sleeper remain preferred; their retained reviews have not established an applicable allowance for the proposed automated routes. Six retained ESPN nonplayer rows do not establish permanent player/category absence. This package selected one alternative, **Polymarket Gamma API**, under a new narrow interpretation of its published unauthenticated integration documentation and personal informational use/copy terms. Scope: bounded API inspection, local original retention and private review. No account, provider API key, payment, trading, bulk/recurring collection or public raw/offer redistribution follows. Wikidata CC0 entity/property evidence independently disambiguates one canonical player; it is not a Gamma-native person ID.

Exactly **12/12 additional source/documentation GETs**: 8 data/identity, 4 documentation/schema; zero redirects, retries or rejected attempts. Bodies total **1,591,978 bytes**, each below 2 MiB. No additional source request was made after exhaustion. Source-specific clocks and the counter are preserved. All agents shared one budget; only the integration owner made these requests.

The linked NBA event contains 60 markets, including 28 unique player-stat markets: **PTS 10, REB 10, AST 8**, across 14 source labels. All **13 requested categories plus PA** remain in the inventory. Other categories were unobserved in this event, not permanently unsupported. Recognized returned families without rules parsers receive an explicit unsupported-parser diagnosis.

Verified source facts include named-player threshold predicates, source event/market IDs, matchup/start, full game including overtime, DNP, postponement/cancellation and official statistical source. Exact supplied exchange arrays/bid/ask remain literal, without sportsbook odds, multiplier, model-probability, EV or parlay conversion. Missing standalone prices remain **PRICE_UNAVAILABLE**.

The actual NBA correction/regrading rule remains unestablished. Current normalized offer-v1 also needs a reviewed canonical identity/composite-selection representation, player-team/opponent bindings and a defined event-version binding. Only four selected-subject observations have independently verified canonical identity; the other 24 do not. Event teams establish a matchup, not player affiliation. No native player or selection ID is invented.

YES/NO threshold semantics are already source-backed. A declared `(market ID, outcome label)` may support a later versioned price-free representation; token mapping is not inherently a price-free offer requirement. Assigning supplied prices requires verified price-to-selection correspondence; executable token quotes additionally require token binding. Those array correspondences are unverified here. Context/readiness/restriction flags are preserved without asserting executable availability or permanent absence.

The offline adapter stages these facts and explicit gaps against the existing settlement contract, with `normalized_capture: null`. It cannot fabricate a complete contract or bypass public admission. Operational encryption-key backup is separate and was not required or changed.

### Local preview, retention and verification

The ignored private preview displays 28 **partial source observations**, readable player/matchup labels, dates, source/canonical IDs in details, separate capture/update/review clocks, exact source arrays, missing-price status, gaps, all fourteen categories and **NO_ACTION**. Static HTML opens without scripts or a server. No actual individual offers, prices, raw bodies, private reports or screenshots were added to Git/public site assets.

Twelve original bodies plus sidecars, ledger and scope decision are retained as 26 create-only local files. Independent copying/replay matched their original hashes. This is **local recovery, not durably verified remote raw archival**. Independent GitHub recovery verifies committed source/evidence, not a provider-signed capture or remote storage of those private originals.

- Required local checks: **650 Python tests / 352.405 s, 86 frontend tests, demo**, manifest and whitespace passed. Initial 649-test run is preserved separately; it is not relabeled.
- Focused synthetic coverage: **8 Python normal, 8 optimized, 8 frontend** passed. Integrity checks use explicit exceptions under `python -O`.
- Actual local Chromium: **six checks**, standalone and module routes at **1440/390/320px**, 28 cards/all fourteen categories, details/gaps/NO_ACTION, no overflow or page errors; **zero external browser requests**. Desktop and 320px screenshots were visually reviewed.
- Independent review fixed high-precision price bounds, observed-but-unsupported family counting and local symlink confinement. **37 reviewed sources, 40 frozen research files and 19 original records / 1,817,800 bytes** remain unchanged.
- GitHub run **39588803255** was rechecked completed/success at the starting d0f2da9a head. Implementation/evidence head 8b46608d passed run **39595640216**. Final documentation-only head **9a7bdcb0 passed [39596602230](https://github.com/NickNicky19/Nicks-multisport-lab-project/actions/runs/39596602230)**, completed October 21 at **12:15:42 UTC**: **650 Python tests / 561.538 s**, **86 frontend tests**, demo, bounded static build, artifact smoke and upload. Operating diagnostic and deployment were both **skipped**. This verifies software/artifact behavior, not a genuine operating cycle or model accuracy.
- Fresh independent final-head GitHub clone/readback passed exact **9a7bdcb019697d972990f81ff31913b75dd44e24**, all **395 manifest entries**, seven unchanged code pins, five receipt seals, four documentation-only changes, all frozen file/record sets and a clean checkout. Final recovery proof SHA256: `ba19c694fed42e9e7924be9212aab549d5301f0c37c4a2d24259bc50f5a60774`.

The public site remains at the previously verified PR #11 merge `411f904e4f9d577f97ca3a4ae6ba52fdb81ee130`, Pages run **39573648815**, with six historical bundles and six historical statistical grades. This package is not merged or deployed. New genuine forecasts, published offers, prospective outcomes/grades, qualified tickets and financial settlements: **all zero**.

### Preserved operating readiness and next concrete tasks

The earlier connected operating work binds normalization to exact encrypted original bytes, validates admission references and protects immutable originals/partial peers and strict local/remote recovery clocks. Certificate and local key-canary checks remain unchanged. Their synthetic checks do not establish actual hosted key recovery or source admission. The frozen producer `06dbb492dda5d0043ec7a3a6c97ce9c46201edc8` diagnostic is not a timing measurement of newer connected components.

Operating preparation remains gated by actual scoped source admission, private-key backup/recovery, trusted runner/raw recovery, reviewed exact-source activation and the original dated windows. The registered reviewed-activation deadline remains October 22 at **23:40 UTC**, followed by capture/persistence/readback **23:40–23:50**, and generation/recovery October 23 **00:00–00:05 UTC**. No clock shift, backfill or activation is authorized. Missing offers/odds do not block an otherwise valid price-independent forecast path. Frozen R0/K0 experiments, full retained history, expired pilot/PR #8, builder scopes/directions/2–6-leg behavior, NFL and MLB are unchanged.

For the next source investigation, retained official navigation identifies **[Get CLOB market info](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/markets/get-clob-market-info)**, `GET /clob-markets/{condition_id}`. First verify its documented server/auth/response meanings, then inspect the exact retained condition if permitted. Do not assume an undocumented older `/markets/{condition_id}` response. An official correction/finality rule applicable to the selected NBA market is a separate required evidence lookup. The exhausted 12-GET allowance needs a new bounded allocation for these specific requests; neither provider credentials nor a universal bespoke-consent requirement is proposed. Keep partial observations if that rule cannot be established. A later reviewed adapter must describe the canonical identity, market/outcome selection, team evidence and event-version recipe explicitly. New linked evidence keeps its own clock.
